tagline: An AI research desk for Indian stocks
brief: A council of AI analysts reads a company's annual report, earnings call and news, debates the bull and bear case, and writes a balanced, fully cited briefing. It informs and never advises (SEBI-safe): no buy/sell calls, every claim traced to its source.
criteria: Success: says 'every claim is cited' at a glance, avoids trading clichés (bulls, bears, candlesticks, arrows, the rupee sign), reads at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Cited
concepts.idea: Folded citation brackets hold three lines of a source; the highlighted line is the exact quote behind a claim.
rationale: Says the product promise, 'nothing without a source', without drawing a chart or an animal
Neel and Haldi: two Indian dye colours; indigo for trust, turmeric for the highlighted quote
The haldi highlight repeats as the dot of the i in the custom wordmark and on every verified quote in the app

recommendation: Cited in Neel & Haldi: ownable in Indian fintech (no one uses an indigo-turmeric pair), clear at 16 px with its small-size cut, and it seeds the product UI directly.
